items.difficulty_reason: 89 行（含 41 行陈述含三张图）、导出范畴交换性验证：K-injective 代表元 + 四等号链构造 + 同伦交换方与 pullback 相容性（! 归约到 * + Sites 两条 stacking remarks）。两处软点披露：同伦交换方的存在为作者断言（箭头全部显示、等号箭头有具名引理，标准 K-injective 论证未展开）；! 到 * 的归约依赖「定义相容」并指针到另一引理的证明。无 verbatim omit。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-shriek-proper-and-open-base-change (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 3046-3086

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: represent K by a K-injective complex and choose K-injective resolutions of g'_! of it; recall from the proof of the previous lemma that the exchange arrow is the 4-term chain g_!f'_* = g_!f'_! = f_!g'_! = f_*g'_! followed by a quasi-isomorphism; lift across the base change using a homotopy-commutative square of quasi-isomorphisms whose equality arrow comes from the proper shriek lemma; show the identifications commute with pullback by reducing from the shriek functors to the star functors (shriek is a subfunctor of star with base change maps defined compatibly, anchored on the proof of the separated base change lemma) and invoking the Sites stacking remarks; the remaining squares commute by the chosen maps (source lines 3088-3176)
